Requirements You've @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at a target.

With a deadly authority, you order your target to halt in their tracks, drop their weapons, and surrender. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Demoralize] your mark. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you. On a critical success, your mark is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] for 1 round.
